description: This file defines a UI navigation bar component named 'NavBar' using the Lightning JavaScript framework. It specifies the template, state, and input behaviors for the component, including styling, positioning, and interaction logic.

classes.name: NavBar
classes.description: A Lightning component representing a navigation bar with a title, underline accent, and menu placeholder.

methods.name: focus
methods.description: Handles focus event by setting underline and chip opacity to fully opaque (1).

methods.name: right
methods.description: Adjusts the horizontal position of the menu placeholder to the right, within screen bounds.

methods.name: left
methods.description: Adjusts the horizontal position of the menu placeholder to the left, within screen bounds.
